# verygood chocolate Sydney

> Small-batch chocolate cakes made to order for birthdays, parties and gifting. Pre-order only. Pickup in Melrose Park, Sydney. No walk-in shop or delivery.

Official AU website: https://au.verygood-chocolate.com
Primary service area: Melrose Park, Sydney

## Ordering
- Choose a cake and options.
- Send a request so availability can be checked.
- Receive payment details after availability is confirmed.
- Collect by pre-arranged pickup in Melrose Park after final confirmation.

## Cakes
- Chocolate Pound Cake & Cupcakes: Choose the pound cake, or make it a dozen cupcakes for AUD 10 more. Chocolate Pound Cake AUD 45; Chocolate Cupcakes (1 dozen) AUD 55. Choose the pound cake or one dozen cupcakes, then choose the available finish. https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/chocolate-pound-cake-and-cupcakes
- Pave Chocolate Cake: A round chocolate cake layered with soft pave ganache and chocolate sponge. Dense, smooth and made for serious chocolate flavour. From AUD 75. 6 inch serves 8, 7.5 inch serves 14, and 9 inch serves 22. Choose a size · dark chocolate only https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/pave-chocolate-cake
- Chocolatier's Basque Cheesecake: Choose classic, pave chocolate on top, or a full pave chocolate finish with one Eiffel Tower chocolate. From AUD 55. Classic AUD 55, pave chocolate on top +AUD 10 (AUD 65 total), or Eiffel Tower finish +AUD 15 (AUD 70 total). One gluten-free 6 inch cake serving about 8, with three finishing options. https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/chocolatiers-basque-cheesecake
- Lemon Cake: Lemon-shaped cakes filled with fresh lemon cream and finished with a floral decoration. From AUD 36. Boxes of 6, 8, 12 or 16. Choose a pack size and finishing mix. The 12-piece box is Most Popular. https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/lemon-cake
- Vanilla Fresh Cream Cake: Made with a chocolate cake sheet and vanilla fresh cream, then Triple berry or Nutella chocolate chip flavour. From AUD 75. 6 inch serves 8, 7.5 inch serves 14, and 9 inch serves 22. Choose size and flavour · Chocolate cake sheet included https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/vanilla-fresh-cream-cake

## Kids cake classes
- Private, hands-on cake classes held in Melrose Park, Sydney on Saturdays and Sundays. Basic welcomes children from Kindy to Year 6; Advanced starts from Year 2.
- Base course/package prices: AUD 99–254.60.
- A Basic + Advanced package covers two separate weekend sessions and receives 5% off the base class fees.
- A 30-minute extension is AUD 20 per participant, per class and is not discounted.
- https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/classes
